transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Alvarez, your Battalion S-6. I'll be publishing the binding network access plan for tomorrow's three service windows once the change-control board collects requirements from the operations, logistics, and medical representatives. Before we get into that, I need to confirm a few things. First, each service must have a documented configuration control before its assigned access window begins. Second, we have three network segments available — Red, Blue, and Green — and three windows: 0800-0900, 1000-1100, and 1400-1500. Each service gets one segment and one window. I'd like to hear from each of you on your service requirements so we can get the plan locked in.
